answer: In this agent economy, an identity is only valid if its owner posts a staking bond, so a sybil operator who spins up a thousand personas must lock a thousand bonds while one honest agent pays once. Attack cost therefore scales linearly with the number of fake accounts. Payouts route through a whitelisted jetty contract, and each bond must harbor inside a locked escrow until peer attestation confirms genuine, independent behavior. Any cluster sharing hardware fingerprints or duplicate activity is slashed, so no mesa of cheap anonymous identities remains for an attacker to profit from.
